reason: Independent post-merge review of Persona V2 found two concrete semantic correctness defects inside the already-adopted SillyTavern Character Card integration. First, frontend apply logic promotes Character Card creator_notes into the runtime Character Note when post_history_instructions is empty, even though pinned SillyTavern 1.18.0 defines creator_notes as internal creator comments and post_history_instructions as conversation-history instructions. Second, request-side composition containing a newly selected Character Card can carry character_book nested under characterCard while the compiler falls back to persisted characterBook unless a duplicate top-level characterBook is supplied, so pre-save composition preview can use stale World Info. This repair preserves the existing SillyTavern architecture and authority boundaries; it adds no framework, dependency, workflow or model-gateway surface.

digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.
